description: PySCIPOpt is an open-source software tool listed in best-of-ps, a ranked list of open-source power-system-analysis projects under the section "software interface", published or maintained by scipopt (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). Python interface for SCIP. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "software interface". It reports 990 GitHub stars and a last repository update on 2026-09-16. Implementation language: Python. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT (as given in the list). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support converting and moving power-system models between tools. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-best-of-ps.
